answer: 18 of 18 faces that state both a pricing and a decision bar state them on different dates; so a join keyed on the date alone cannot tell which bar a consumer means on those faces: the name join is load-bearing there, and 173 further faces state several dates without carrying both roles
limits: role is decided by the key name from the E594 dialect vocabulary; a bar stored under a name outside that vocabulary is invisible here
a date is read from an ISO-8601 prefix on a string value; an epoch integer or a prose date states nothing to this instrument and is classed as no date
lists are walked 20 elements deep at 3 levels, so a heterogeneous list longer than that contributes only its head
faces above 1000000 bytes are published as too_big rather than parsed
